title: The Ostrich

details.name: The Eye
details.note: The largest eye of any land animal — fringed with double lashes.

details.name: The Brain
details.note: Drawn beside the eye that dwarfs it: the brain is smaller than either eye.

details.name: The Foot
details.note: Two toes only, where every other living bird has three or four.

details.name: The Egg
details.note: Some fifteen centimetres long; the largest egg laid by any living bird.

lines.text: Plate twelve. The ostrich: Struthio camelus.
The eye, magnified: the largest of any land animal, fringed with double lashes.
The brain, drawn beside the eye that dwarfs it: smaller than either eye.
The foot: two toes only, where every other living bird has three or four.
A grown cock stands two metres seventy, and a single stride covers three full metres.
lines.asr: A grown cock stands 2 meters 70 and a single stride covers 3 full meters

lines.text: The cock digs the nest, and the hen by day and the cock by night keep the largest egg of any living bird.
